decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera sits squarely in the firm's core optoelectronic heritage, still has its own page, and benefits from accumulated mission knowledge that lets the firm keep improving it.
The modular camera line flew on ESA's HERA mission, showing proven performance in a field where the firm's existing knowledge and R&D let it absorb flight feedback and extend the models.
The situational awareness sensor suite builds on the firm's sensor know-how and serves a growing market, and the firm's research cooperation helps it interpret early results and refine the offer.

The miniaturized LiDAR extends the firm's established docking and LiDAR expertise toward smaller satellites, matching its strategic direction, even though it has so far only been mentioned on the website.
The radiation-hard camera line is a recent launch close to the core offer with its own page, and the firm's space-qualification know-how and test infrastructure support continued development.
The asteroid navigation camera is tied to the successful HERA mission heritage, so the firm can learn from flight data and reuse the design for future deep-space missions.
